segments.tts: Has AI ever won a roast battle? Actually… yes. Sometimes.

In 2023, a ChatGPT-powered comedy bot reportedly beat a human comic at a roast battle in New York. But at a Toronto show pitting comics against an AI avatar, the AI won only two battles. And in San Francisco, a rapper out-roasted an AI Confucius.
So let's settle it. Ture versus me!
Bouncy, you're so round, even your opinions have no edges.
Oh yeah? Ture, your beard has more parameters than my whole model.
Final score: humans one, AI one. The roast war is officially a tie.
